name: story-sing-along
description: Kids' nursery-rhyme sing-along video from a text brief, song first: original lyrics written by a rhyme formula to an exact line count, one timeline with one row per sung line, one sung song that becomes the clock, a character sheet and one mid-action start frame per clip, 9:16 multi-shot 3D cartoon clips cut on the sung lines, a trim-from-end stitch with the song as the only sound, and karaoke lyric captions built from the known words. Use when: a customer orders a nursery rhyme, toddler song, counting, countdown, lullaby, action or dance song video, a new song echoing a classic, or a change to a sing-along this skill delivered (caption words or style, a wrong shot, a range cut, a title, 16:9 or 1:1). NOT for: a narrated story or musical with a storyteller (not offered); a song or music bed alone (media-audio-generation); speech captions on another video (edit-captions); a general shot-planned film (media-video-production); a one-take short from an idea (story-one-take-short); file checks (media-qc).
